name: How Many Children Did Adam And Eve Have
overview: Scripture reveals that Adam and Eve were commanded by God to be fruitful and multiply, establishing the foundation for human multiplication and dominion over the earth. The Genesis account specifically names three of their children: Cain, Abel, and Seth, indicating that their family grew beyond these initial sons. These passages highlight God's sovereign plan in continuing the human lineage through Adam and Eve, even after the fall, with Seth being appointed as a replacement for Abel, whom Cain had slain.
